pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, multi-sided polygonal patches with relatively smooth edge gradients. The dark regions exhibit a high spatial area relative to the inter-patch spaces, particularly on the upper flank where patches are larger and more densely packed.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored inter-patch pathways forming a geometric web. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank but narrows where patches exhibit sharper vertices.
